plugins.name: puml-plantuml
plugins.description: Full-stack PlantUML expert: create PUML from descriptions, convert images to PUML (vision reverse engineering), and render locally (PNG/SVG/PDF) offline. Auto-installs PlantUML + Java. Covers all 27 chapters of the PlantUML Language Reference Guide.

skills.name: puml-plantuml
skills.description: Full-stack PlantUML expert: create PUML from descriptions, convert images to PUML (vision reverse engineering), render locally (PNG/SVG/PDF) with no internet. macOS/Windows/Linux; auto-installs PlantUML+Java+Python. Covers all 27 chapters of the PlantUML Language Reference Guide v1.2025.0 (607 pages): Sequence, Use Case, Class, Object, Activity (legacy+new), Component, Deployment, State, Timing, JSON, YAML, nwdiag, Salt/Wireframe, Archimate, Gantt, MindMap, WBS, Maths, ER, Common Commands, Creole, Sprites, Skinparam, Preprocessing, Unicode, StdLib (C4/AWS/Azure/K8s/ArchiMate). Use for: draw a diagram, create PUML, convert image to PUML, render .puml, debug PUML, explain PlantUML syntax, any UML task.
headings: Complete Diagram Coverage (All 27 Chapters from PDF)
skills.description_zh: 按文字生成PlantUML、从图片反向提取PUML并在本地渲染PNG/SVG/PDF，也可调试语法；原说明覆盖语言参考v1.2025.0的UML、甘特、思维导图、ER及标准库，支持macOS/Windows/Linux并自动准备Java、Python和PlantUML。
